prompt: I'm a luxury real estate agent in Miami. I want a page for a $4.2M waterfront penthouse at Azure Tower. Target: high-net-worth buyers, international investors.
assertions: Output is a single valid HTML file
Uses Tailwind CDN and GSAP CDN
Has checkerboard grid layout with 8 columns
Has scroll-pinned sections with enter/exit choreography
Accent color is NOT the default pink
Has a Card Grid section showing property features or rooms
Copy mentions the property or real estate context
Includes a contact/CTA section with form
Page title includes Azure Tower or brand name
All spatial typography words are 6 characters or fewer
Global snap targets pinned range centers (not starts)
Contact section footer is in normal flow (not position absolute)
Contact section has z-[70] or z-index >= 70
All nav anchor hrefs match section ids
Card buttons consistently at bottom via margin-top auto
